newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Intria drops plan to buy FCW stake.
newsitem.headline: Intria drops plan to buy FCW stake.

text.p: Malaysian infrastructure developer Intria Bhd said on Tuesday it has dropped a plan to buy into FCW Holdings Bhd after a revised acquisition price was rejected by the vendors of the FCW shares.
Intria last year proposed to acquire a 30.1 percent stake in construction firm FCW from Ivory Quest Sdn Bhd for 364 million ringgit or 6.50 ringgit a share.
But in March, the proposed acquisition price approved by market regulator Securities Commission (SC), was reduced to 285.6 million ringgit or 5.10 ringgit a share.
FCW stock closed on Tuesday at 4.04 ringgit.
"Ivory Quest has confirmed in writing, the non-acceptance of the revision in purchase consideration imposed by the SC", thus terminating an earlier conditional agreement, Intria said in a statement.
